title: Authoritative Overlay
description: Cross-checks extracted financial numbers against the US SEC EDGAR
company-concept API for a configured CIK, scoped to a filing period
(form / fy / fp / start / end / frame). Abstains (drops) the answer if there is no match.

authoritative_overlay.regulator_type.title: Regulator Source
authoritative_overlay.regulator_type.description: Which regulator database to cross-check against

authoritative_overlay.cik.title: Company CIK
authoritative_overlay.cik.description: The SEC Central Index Key for the company.
